title: Baseline Box-Set Inbounds
description: A classic box formation for a baseline inbound, with staggered screens creating a look for either a layup or a corner three.

content.objective: Run a clean box inbounds set that creates either a rim finish or an open corner three.
content.setup: Four players set up in a box shape near the free-throw line with the inbounder on the baseline.
instructions: Two players screen for each other across the lane as the play begins.
The first cutter looks for a layup off the first screen.
If denied, the second cutter pops to the corner for a three off a staggered screen.
The inbounder reads both options and delivers to whichever is open.
coachingPoints: Set screens that are legal and stationary before any contact.
Cutters should read the defense, not run the pattern blindly.
Inbounder needs to be ready to deliver to either option quickly.
commonMistakes: Cutters running the pattern even when a defender has clearly taken it away.
Screens set too late to actually free anyone.
Losing focus on the details once the simulated pressure is on.
content.safety: Screens must be legal and stationary; defenders should avoid unnecessary contact when fighting through.
